planned_sets_load_all_or_nothing.name: planned_sets_load_all_or_nothing
planned_sets_load_all_or_nothing.value:
("app"."planned_sets"."load_kind" IS NULL AND "app"."planned_sets"."load_amount_milli" IS NULL AND "app"."planned_sets"."load_unit" IS NULL AND "app"."planned_sets"."load_basis" IS NULL)
          OR ("app"."planned_sets"."load_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."planned_sets"."load_amount_milli" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."planned_sets"."load_unit" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."planned_sets"."load_basis" IS NOT NULL)

loading_capabilities_payload_matches_kin.name: loading_capabilities_payload_matches_kind
loading_capabilities_payload_matches_kin.value:
("app"."loading_capabilities"."kind" = 'FIXED_INCREMENT' AND "app"."loading_capabilities"."fixed_increment_amount_milli" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."loading_capabilities"."enumerated_loads_milli" IS NULL)
          OR ("app"."loading_capabilities"."kind" = 'ENUMERATED_LIST' AND "app"."loading_capabilities"."enumerated_loads_milli" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."loading_capabilities"."fixed_increment_amount_milli" IS NULL)

progression_applications_applied_audit_g.name: progression_applications_applied_audit_group_consistency
progression_applications_applied_audit_g.value:
("app"."progression_applications"."loading_capability_id" IS NULL) = ("app"."progression_applications"."loading_capability_revision" IS NULL)
          AND ("app"."progression_applications"."loading_capability_id" IS NULL) = ("app"."progression_applications"."loading_capability_snapshot" IS NULL)
          AND ("app"."progression_applications"."loading_capability_id" IS NULL) = ("app"."progression_applications"."resolver_proposed_load" IS NULL)
          AND ("app"."progression_applications"."loading_capability_id" IS NULL) = ("app"."progression_applications"."applied_load" IS NULL)
          AND ("app"."progression_applications"."loading_capability_id" IS NULL) = ("app"."progression_applications"."applied_at" IS NULL)

equipment_adaptation_applications_consum.name: equipment_adaptation_applications_consumed_consistent
equipment_adaptation_applications_consum.value: ("app"."equipment_adaptation_applications"."status" = 'CONSUMED') = ("app"."equipment_adaptation_applications"."consumed_by_workout_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."equipment_adaptation_applications"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)
